in_marathi.name: Bidyadhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom or knowledge giver
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bidyadhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bidyadhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bidya' which means knowledge or wisdom, and 'Dhar' which means giver or supporter. This name is given to a child who is believed to bring knowledge and wisdom to the family or society.
